lead.headline: Rice is out and Jacobs waits a week — the rest of your lineup is cleared
lead.deck: Tuten is active in London. Your only backup quarterback, Stroud, locks at 07:30 — before Daniels plays on Monday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice is out with his hamstring and Josh Jacobs is on the Commissioner's Exempt List until Monday, eligible from Week 7. Los Cachanillas banked 5.2 on Thursday and repaired their lineup on Saturday. Your side is clean: Tuten is active in London, Taylor, Wilson, Likely, Golden and Pickens are off their final reports, and CeeDee Lamb's full week of practice means Pickens plays beside him, as ESPN's 13.6 assumes. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.7 against 110.4, ESPN 59%. One thing to know: Stroud plays at 07:30, so if Daniels were a Monday scratch there would be no quarterback to put in. Nothing in Washington's report points that way.
